run.executedVia: Playwright driving Lightning Experience. Every screen assertion is cross-checked against the ServiceNow record over cnit and the Salesforce record over the sf CLI. No case in this file writes to either platform.

case.title: Both lists are shown side by side

steps.text: Open the evidence panel on CAFT0001052, which holds files on both sides.
Confirm each column against its own platform.

records.label: Files linked to the task in Salesforce
records.query: sf data query --query "SELECT ContentDocument.Title, ContentDocument.ContentSize FROM ContentDocumentLink WHERE LinkedEntityId IN (SELECT Id FROM CAF_Task__c WHERE SN_Number__c = 'CAFT0001052')" --target-org caf-sf

observations: Two copies on purpose, and not reconciled. Salesforce’s copy makes preview and download work with no round trip; ServiceNow’s is the copy an auditor is entitled to and the only one the attestation gate counts.
expected: The panel lists Salesforce files and ServiceNow attachments separately.
A failed push is therefore visible rather than inferred.
actual: Panel shows two separate columns: "Salesforce Files" (0) and "ServiceNow attachments" (1).

ServiceNow column lists: encryption-config.txt
